data.one_liner: A Flutter widget providing a swipe-to-action button to prevent accidental clicks.
data.what_it_does: Provides a SwipeButton widget that requires users to swipe horizontally rather than just tap, helping avoid accidental activations or triggers. Supports customization of colors, dimensions, borders, and elevation.
use_when: You want to prevent accidental clicks on destructive actions like deleting data or confirming orders.
You need a standard slider-to-unlock or swipe-to-confirm UI pattern.
avoid_when: You need standard tap-based buttons for fast navigation or simple actions.
You require complex multi-step swipe gestures beyond a single horizontal confirmation track.
strengths: Simple and intuitive API with multiple constructors like SwipeButton.expand.
Highly customizable track and thumb colors, elevations, and border radii.
weaknesses: Relies entirely on standard widget styling without built-in icon packs or complex animations.
